_README: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — safe to commit. Copy to cases.local.json and replace with real cases.
id            unique string; appears in the report, so name it after the source
text          the realistic text to scan
expect        list of {entity, value} that MUST be found. Keyed on VALUE, not offset,
because offsets move when text is edited and region-splitting can shift them.
must_not_flag list of entity types that must NOT fire on this case. This is how the
known-broad national-ID recognizers are pinned down.
A case with expect: [] and no must_not_flag asserts the text is clean.
Include BOTH genuine-PII cases and look-alike clean cases. A corpus of only
positives rewards detectors that find less — that is the trap this format exists to avoid.

cases.text: Para consultas sobre el expediente, escribir a maria.gonzalez@ejemplo.gob.sv o llamar al +504 2234-5678. La titular, Rosa Maria Alvarez, presenta su documento de identidad.
cases.note: Genuine PII in government prose. PERSON is optional here because NER boundaries vary by model — drop it if the detector legitimately disagrees about the span, but never drop the EMAIL.

cases.text: Orbital period 365.25 days. Distance 149597870.7 km. Perihelion 147098291 km. Aphelion 152097291 km. Mass 5.9722e24 kg. Survey reference 20261012.
cases.note: THE KNOWN FALSE-POSITIVE CASE. Bare 8/9/10/13/17-digit regexes fire on the long numbers here. A detector that flags any of these is costing you the curator's attention for nothing.

cases.text: El Ministerio de Agricultura y Ganadería, a través de la Dirección de Política Agrícola, publicó el boletín estadístico del segundo trimestre. La oficina regional de San Salvador reporta 124000 hectáreas.
cases.note: San Salvador is a place and the ministry is an organisation — neither is a natural person, so neither is personal data under GDPR Art. 4(1) on its own. A PERSON firing here is pure noise. Note also that '124000' is six digits, below every national-ID pattern length, so it should stay clean.

cases.text: Pago mediante IBAN ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332, titular Sr. Juan Perez.
cases.note: High-value structured identifier. If a tuning change suppresses THIS to quiet the numeric noise, the change has gone too far.
